faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Clayton?
faq.answer: Clayton homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project. This small Contra Costa community features a mix of 1970s–1990s homes near downtown and newer developments in the Oakhurst Country Club area. Window count typically ranges from 10 to 16 per project.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Clayton?
faq.answer: Yes. Clayton requires a building permit for window replacement. Projects involving changes to the rough opening or structural framing require a full building permit; like-for-like replacements may qualify for expedited review. Our team handles all permitting for Clayton projects on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Clayton?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Clayton commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Clayton?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Clayton replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Clayton?
faq.answer: Most Clayton projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
